FORGE FINALE -- session 5: a real architectural finding

Skipped the momentum fix for now -- it needs a more expensive function call inside the search's hottest loop, and I'm not going to sneak a performance cost into the 90-minute calibration without flagging that tradeoff first.

Instead mapped the threshold system your completion doc specifically asks about. Real finding: there's a global (g_CurrentThreshold) that 18 different places in the file carefully write to -- but the function that actually decides live trades doesn't read it at all. It has its own separate calculation. The natural "getter" for that global is dead code (zero callers) -- same pattern as the slingshot bug from session 4. Looks like an older parameter-search system (still writing to it) got superseded by the newer regime-based system without anyone removing the old wiring. Not fixed yet -- flagging it, and checking next whether that old system is even still running at all live.

Score: 11/45 still, but 6 unknowns now down to being real answers instead of "nobody checked."
